nennungen.name: ROHN INDUSTRIES INC  (CIK 0000315641)
nennungen.fenster: res. The Company manufactures many configurations of towers, ranging from a 2,000-foot high tower to small antenna mounts. The Company's principal tower product is the tubular self-supporting tower ranging in heights up to 900 feet. The Company's towers are used across the world for television broadcast, AM/FM radio broadcast, microwave, cellular telephone, PCS, radar, surveillance camera mounts, solar power stations and weather stations. Included within the Tower Structures segment are steel and concrete poles, generally used where space is too limited to erect a tower and antenna mounts that are hot-dipped galvanized to prevent corrosion.
